_meta.purpose: Tracks per-screen CCC certification status. Every screen in any journey must appear here. Claude updates after every action audit touching a screen.
_meta.regressionGuardBlockingRule: A screen CANNOT reach CERT-PASS if any entry in its knownIssues array has regressionGuardStatus != PASS. regressionGuardStatus=MISSING means no guard exists and blocks CERT-PASS.
_meta.regressionGuardSeverityRule: For issues with severity=CRITICAL or severity=HIGH: regressionGuardType MUST be one of UNIT_TEST | API_INTEGRATION | E2E | RUNTIME_ASSERTION_WITH_LOG_CHECK. 'Structural proof only' or 'documented in notes' does NOT satisfy guard requirements for CRITICAL/HIGH issues. For MEDIUM/LOW: documented structural proof is acceptable only with explicit auditNote explaining why automation is not feasible.
_meta.fixClosureRule: A knownIssue may be recorded as code-fixed in history, but it is NOT closure-eligible for screen certification, truth-sync, or deploy gating until regressionGuardStatus=PASS and regressionGuardRef points to the executable or cited guard.
_meta.codeStateBoundaryRule: A code-fix commit touching this screen's files must not also modify RELEASES/, workflow/state/, or RELEASES/LIVE_TESTING_ISSUES.md. State/tracker updates belong in a separate STATE_ONLY commit.
_meta.operatorCertificationRule: Operator runtime certification for a screen is invalid if the candidate SHA or the governing machine-state SHA is not pushed to origin/main at time of certification. It is also invalid if collected outside the correct liveTestingLifecycle phase: baseline discovery in PHASE_2, post-fix certification in PHASE_4, exploratory only in PHASE_5.
_meta.scopeLockRule: At session start: for each file in scopeLock.files, run git log --oneline -1 -- <path>. If returned SHA != auditedAtSha (exact mismatch, not 'newer than'), set reauditRequired=true on that file and screen status=NEEDS-REAUDIT. List reason in reauditReasons. Null auditedAtSha means never audited — treat as requiring audit, not as 'no change'.
_meta.claudeRule: When a journey action for a screen is audited, update cccLevelsCompleted. When all journey actions for a screen are result=PASS, set screen status=CERT-PASS only if: (a) no knownIssue has regressionGuardStatus != PASS, (b) all sixGuarantees for all journeys using this screen are signed.

knownIssues.rootCause: syncProductsToOffline wrote server-stale stock to SQLite even when in-memory cache was pinned. setCatalogItems(fresh) then loaded stale rows, overwriting React state with currentStock: 0.
knownIssues.fixDescription: Check resolveStockForSku before upsertLocalProduct. If pin active, write pinned value to SQLite instead of server value. stockCache.ts:128-131 blocks background overwrites of pinned entries.
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: 4 tests: pinned entry NOT overwritten by background refresh; re-pin overwrites; non-pinned overwrites normally; multi-key batch. All PASS at bd81f502.

knownIssues.rootCause: SkuItem array in state not updated after manual stock edit; stockRefreshTick not bumped.
knownIssues.fixDescription: Added SkuItem array update after stock edit (SellScanScreen.tsx:2109-2117) + stockRefreshTick bump to force FlatList re-render. pinStockEntries ensures resolveStockForSku returns confirmed stock.
knownIssues.regressionGuardRef: src/__tests__/services/stockCache.regression.test.ts — describe('ISSUE-042: confirmed stock is readable via resolveStockForSku after pin')
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: 3 tests: resolveStockForSku returns pinned stock by productId; by barcode; returns null when absent. All PASS at bd81f502. UI setCatalogItems logic covered by structural proof at SellScanScreen.tsx:2108-2117 (ISSUE-042 comment in code).

knownIssues.rootCause: Barcode-only guard at line 1678 prevents VALIDATION_ERROR on text search input.
knownIssues.fixDescription: Pre-existing guard at SellScanScreen.tsx:1684-1687: /^\d{8,}$/.test(trimmed) — only routes to onBarcodeScanned if input is 8+ numeric digits.
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: MEDIUM severity — structural proof + regex logic test. Tests verify barcode-like inputs route correctly and non-barcode text (milk, scan, 7-digit, mixed) do NOT trigger scan handler. PASS at bd81f502.

knownIssues.rootCause: loadingSale in useEffect deps caused React to run cleanup (cancelled=true) and re-run the effect every time setLoadingSale(true) was called. In-flight async work then bailed on if (cancelled) return, so setSaleId/setBillRef were never called.
knownIssues.fixDescription: Added createSaleInFlightRef = useRef(false). Replaced loadingSale guard with createSaleInFlightRef.current. Removed loadingSale from deps array. Ref cleared in .finally() before cancelled check.
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: CRITICAL severity — executable test mandatory (E2E or API_INTEGRATION). Test must: mount PaymentScreen with items, assert Complete Payment button enables within 3s without user action. Structural proof alone rejected.

knownIssues.rootCause: Same as ISSUE-051 — payment chain unblocked by same fix.
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: CRITICAL severity — same test as ISSUE-051 must cover this path explicitly.

knownIssues.rootCause: productId mapping wrong in productsApi + storeProductDigitisationService for createSale variant resolution.
knownIssues.fixDescription: Fixed productId mapping in productsApi and storeProductDigitisationService.
knownIssues.regressionGuardNote: HIGH severity — executable test required. Test must: createSale with storeProductId-mapped product, assert saleId returned. API_INTEGRATION or E2E.

deployGate.rule: A deploy candidate requires ALL screens in the target cluster's journeys to be CERT-PASS. No partial deployment of CERT-PENDING screens.
deployGate.regressionGuardBlockingRule: Any screen with a knownIssue where regressionGuardStatus=MISSING or regressionGuardStatus=FAIL BLOCKS deploy. No exceptions.
deployGate.scopeLockViolationRule: Any screen with a file in scopeLock that has reauditRequired=true BLOCKS deploy until re-audit completes.
deployGate.currentBlockers: All screens CERT-PENDING or CERT-IN-PROGRESS. All knownIssues have regressionGuardStatus=MISSING.
deployGate.nextDeployEligibleWhen: JOURNEY-02 + JOURNEY-03 + JOURNEY-04 + JOURNEY-05 all CERT-SEALED. All regressionGuardStatus=PASS for C1 screens.

operatorFatigueRules.rule: Operator tests at most 4 journeys per session. Each journey has a pre-written structured script. Operator follows script exactly and logs pass/fail per step. No freestyle exploration until scripted pass is complete.
operatorFatigueRules.structuredScriptFormat: Each step: precondition + action + expectedOutcome. Operator logs: actualOutcome + PASS|FAIL.
operatorFatigueRules.operatorIsLastLineNotFirstLine: Operator testing confirms what Claude certified. It does not discover basic flow breakage. If operator finds basic breakage, that is a CCC audit failure — fix the audit, not just the code.
operatorFatigueRules.runtimeEvidenceRequired: Operator fills runtimeEvidence[] in JOURNEY_MAP.json for each action tested. Claude verifies all 12 required fields are present before CERT-SEALED. Entries with missing fields are INVALID and block sealing.

runtimeEvidenceFormat._ref: Canonical schema is in RELEASES/JOURNEY_MAP.json _meta.runtimeEvidenceSchema. All 12 fields below are REQUIRED.
runtimeEvidenceFormat.capturedAt: ISO 8601 timestamp — when evidence was captured
runtimeEvidenceFormat.capturedSha: git SHA of HEAD at capture time — prevents stale evidence reuse
runtimeEvidenceFormat.storeId: test store ID — must match seededStateLock.requiredData
runtimeEvidenceFormat.artifactPath: path to screenshot/log, or 'none' for OPERATOR_CONFIRMED
runtimeEvidenceFormat.summary: one-line description of what was observed
runtimeEvidenceFormat.actualOutcome: exact description of what happened — not expected, actual
runtimeEvidenceFormat.operatorConfirmed: true if operator physically confirmed this
